import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,re
p=Path.cwd(); ids=set(json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])
def write(n,s):
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
records=[]
base=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
# Actual corpus is under batch2, two ancestors above new-twenty.
base=p.parent.parent/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
for f in sorted(base.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes(); ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for no,line in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  obj=json.loads(line); mid=obj.get('id',obj.get('mathdb_id'))
  if mid not in ids: continue
  print('LITERAL',mid,json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False))
  records.append(dict(id=mid,chunk=str(f),chunk_sha256=ch,line=no,raw_line=line.decode(),raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest(),newline=line.endswith(b'\n')))
write('originals.json',json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('FOUND',len(records))
print('ALLOWLIST', (p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text())
print('DENIALSIZE',len((p/'inherited-denials.json').read_text()))
